result_text:
That notification is only my wait loop being stopped at its time limit. It was a leftover `pgrep` wait I started, not part of the change, and it doesn't affect the result.

The test run had already finished before that. `mvn -q -o test` exited with code 0 and showed no failures. The tail of its output was just my grep for `SELECT` lines that don't read `assigned_agent`. It listed four, all unrelated to the ticket lists (a customer closure insert, the open-on-date count, the close-time average and the closed-tickets report). I did not add a test for the new agent field.

The change is as I described in the last message: the new `assigned_agent` column, the `assignedAgent` field on `SupportTicket`, every ticket query in `DataStore` reading it, and the new `SupportTicketService.create` overload. Nothing is committed.
